map.集成标准视力表（如 E 字表、字母表、logMAR 表）与测距参考，按正确视距查: Integrates standard charts (E, letter, logMAR) and distance reference; at the correct distance read the smallest row to estimate unaided or corrected vision. Self-test is for reference only; for glasses and diagnosis see a doctor.
map.视力自查：定期看是否下降: Vision self-check: periodically see if it drops
map.护眼提醒：发现模糊及时就医: Eye-care reminder: see a doctor if blur appears
map.选表与设定视距（如 5 米）: Pick a chart and set viewing distance (e.g. 5 m)
map.遮一只眼，从大往小认到最后能看清的行: Cover one eye, read from large to small until the smallest clear row
map.记录该行视力值: Record the vision value of that row
map.标准视距与照明很重要，家里可用米尺量: Standard viewing distance and lighting matter; at home use a meter stick
map.眯眼会虚高结果，别偷瞄: Squinting inflates results; do not peek
map.屏幕像素密度影响小字号清晰度: Screen pixel density affects small-text clarity
map.视力下降明显请眼科就诊: Marked vision drop: see an ophthalmologist
map.5.0 和 1.0 视力是什么关系？: What is the relation between 5.0 and 1.0 vision?
map.是中国标准对数（5 分制）与小数记录的两种写法，约略对应同一视力。: These are the two notations of the Chinese standard logarithmic (5-point) and decimal records, roughly the same vision.
map.只能看趋势，因距离、屏幕、光线难标准化，正式以验光为准。: Trend only; distance, screen, and lighting are hard to standardize; for formal results rely on refraction.
